title: Pan-fried beef steaks with courgette and parsley pesto
blurb: Tender beef steaks served with sautéed courgettes and a fresh parsley and garlic pesto.
steps: Make the pesto by blending the parsley, half the garlic, pine nuts, half the olive oil, a squeeze of lemon juice and a pinch of salt until fairly smooth.
Cut the courgettes into rounds about half a centimetre thick and halve the tomatoes.
Season the steaks on both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat half the remaining oil in a large frying pan over high heat and cook the steaks for three to four minutes each side for medium, then set aside to rest.
Add the rest of the oil to the same pan and fry the courgettes with the remaining garlic for five minutes until golden.
Add the tomatoes to the pan and cook for two minutes until they start to soften.
Slice the steaks and serve with the courgettes and tomatoes, spooning the parsley pesto over the top.
